ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_001_weight_normalized_repair
ir.intuition: Combines log probabilities difference weighted by alpha and scale, offset by cost_gap; normalizes weights to ensure scale-invariant weighted sum of pairwise losses.
ir.pseudocode:
x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * cost_gap
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
losses = -logsigmoid(x)
weight_sum = sum(weight)
norm_weight = weight / clamp(weight_sum, 1e-6, 1e6)
loss = sum(losses * norm_weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch.get("weight", lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    cost_gap = batch["cost_gap"]
    alpha = float(extra.get("alpha", extra.get("hyperparams", {}).get("alpha", 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get("hyperparams", {}).get("scale", 1.9496803035382082))
    x = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    x = ops.mul(alpha * scale, x)
    x = ops.sub(x, ops.mul(0.1, cost_gap))
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    losses = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    norm_weight = ops.div(weight, ops.clamp(weight_sum, eps, 1e6))
    loss = ops.sum(ops.mul(losses, norm_weight))
    return loss
